title: Low Level Benchmarking Framework for Memory and Execution Time in R
text: package offers low level framework benchmarking memory usage execution time R functions. designed assist developers analysts profiling optimizing performance code, particularly long-running functions processes rely heavily disk /O memory database queries like arrow duckdb can benchmark classic methods. Key Features: Detailed Profiling: Measures memory usage execution time functions, providing insights performance. Error Reporting: Captures errors execution aid debugging improve reliability. achieve goal, timemoir fork R process executes function, main process read memory usage /proc/<pid>/status. title: Low Level Benchmarking Framework for Memory and Execution Time in R
code: library(timemoir)  test_function <- function(n) {   x <- rnorm(n); mean(x) }  timemoir(   test_function(1e3),   test_function(1e6),   test_function(1e8) ) #> benchmarking test_function(1000)  :  #> benchmarking test_function(1e+06) :  #> benchmarking test_function(1e+08) : .. #> # A tibble: 3 × 5 #>   fname                duration error start_mem max_mem #>   <chr>                   <dbl> <chr>     <dbl>   <dbl> #> 1 test_function(1000)  0.000362 <NA>     102512  100976 #> 2 test_function(1e+06) 0.0252   <NA>     102384  100976 #> 3 test_function(1e+08) 2.59     <NA>     102512  884080

text: ... functions benchmark. verbose boolean. TRUE (default) print information messages. n integer. number time function must run (default 1) interval (default 0.1) sleep interval memory check sec

title: Benchmark functions — timemoir
text: result tibble one row per benchmarked function 5 columns: fname, function name (string). duration duration (sec) function NA function fails. error, error message function fails, NA otherwise. start_mem memory used function benchmark (KB). max_mem max used memory (KB).
